component.name: Condenser
component.summary: Cut clips from Steam game recordings and export them to MP4

description.p: Condenser turns hours of Steam background recordings into short clips. It opens on your most recent session in a big player, lets you mark a start and end on the timeline, and exports the clip as MP4, either without re-encoding or as widely playable H.264 encoded on the GPU.
Condenser is based on Pineapple Steam Recording Exporter by Gary "BLumia" Wang.
First Condenser release, forked from Pineapple Steam Recording Exporter 0.6.0.
